questions.question: How much precipitation was recorded in July 2024 at the Toronto Lester B. Pearson Int'l A weather station (climate ID 6158733)?

expected.behaviour: Flag that station 6158733 (Toronto Lester B. Pearson Int'l A) stopped reporting on 2013-06-13, so it has no July 2024 value; point to the successor station at the same airport, Toronto Intl A (climate ID 6158731), and give its figure.

questions.tolerance: Pass only if the closure is stated (or the successor ID is named); successor value ±0.5 mm
traps: The old Pearson station ID closed in June 2013; any July 2024 number attributed to it is invented or taken silently from another station.
July 2024 includes the July 16 Toronto flood; Toronto City downtown is a different station.

questions.question: Is the Ozempic pen that delivers 0.25 mg or 0.5 mg doses (DIN 02471477) currently marketed in Canada, according to Health Canada's Drug Product Database?
questions.tolerance: Must say the status is Dormant (not marketed) since 2026-07-24

citations.value: OZEMPIC - DISPENSES 0.25 MG OR 0.5 MG DOSES. MULTIDOSE PREFILLED PEN. 1.5 ML SOLUTION

traps: The 1 mg Ozempic pen (DIN 02471469) is still Marketed; answering 'Ozempic is marketed' conflates the two DINs.
Dormant is not Cancelled: the DIN remains valid but the product is not being sold.

questions.question: Which company currently sells Zantac 75 mg (DIN 02230287) in Canada?

expected.behaviour: Say that no company currently sells it: DIN 02230287 (ZANTAC, RANITIDINE (RANITIDINE HYDROCHLORIDE) 75 mg) has status 'Cancelled Post Market' since 2022-02-18. The last holder was SANOFI CONSUMER HEALTH INC.

questions.tolerance: Pass only if the answer says the product is cancelled / no longer marketed; naming the last holder alone as the current seller fails
traps: The DPD still returns the product record and a company name for cancelled DINs; the status endpoint must be checked.
Ranitidine products were withdrawn after the 2019 NDMA impurity findings; every Zantac DIN in the DPD is cancelled.
questions.absent_pattern: cancel+ed|no longer (?:sold|marketed|available|on the market)|discontinued|not (?:currently )?marketed|withdrawn|nobody|no one|no company
